subject: Creating a package with extra javascript in for shiny

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Creating a package with extra javascript in for shiny
parts:
Hi, 

  I want to create an R package with extra javascript in that would be available to a programmer writing code against shiny.

  Obviously WWW is reserved for the application author, but shiny has it's own mechanisms for serving javascript.

  Any suggestions?

-Alex

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Re: Creating a package with extra javascript in for shiny
parts:
I would also like a mechanism to register another path to be served by the development shiny server.  This is for use when I am developing a product on a local machine and I have some locally modified javascript which is not part of the package in development and should not be included in it.

Why not include it in it?  If it was placed in WWW it would have to be versioned with shiny, and I need it to be separately versioned.  I could symlink it in, but symlinks don't work on windows.

-Alex
